title: sofa cover
text: sofa cover. Purchased this to cover an olive toned sleeper loveseat I just purchased.  It's perfect.  A word about the measurements - I purchased 2 sizes because I wasn't sure about how to measure.... the 46" fit perfectly and is the measurement between the 2 arms, INSIDE.  Just in case I can save you the hassle of doing as I did and purchasing 2!  The back is rubber swiss dot to help it from slipping a lot.  The arm covers offer pockets on both arms - just as photographed in the ad.  The top is soft and comfy to sit on with a lovely design quilting - sort of diamond shaped cross or flower?  Depends on how you look at it.  The back strip falls down fairly far on mine, which I am thrilled with as it will protect the actual sofa fabric from the sun.  Will depend on how tall the back of your piece is.  I believe you could possibly wash this carefully and hang dry - as I would not want to harm the rubber dots on the back.  Overall, I believe this was a great purchase and value!
